audit.whatIsWrong: The content level chart gave Gragas five of seven stages, but the whys text under three of them says the opposite ('neither of you wins level 1', 'call it even', 'a knife's edge', 'he out-scales'). The packet levelChart is Skill/Gragas/Skill/Gragas/Gragas/Skill/Kassadin and the 48.55% win rate over 344 games is not a favoured lane.
audit.why: Level 1 Gragas has one ability and Void Stone cuts his magic poke; level 3 his cooldowns are long; first item is a Riftmaker-vs-Rod-of-Ages race; two items Kassadin has Riftwalk at 2s and out-scales.
audit.corrected: Content chart flipped as one group to match the packet and the existing whys: 1 Skill, 2 Gragas, 3 Skill, 4-5 Gragas, 6 Gragas, first item Skill, 2+ items Kassadin. Full layer phases[6] flipped to Kassadin, matching the mirror audit which flipped 2+ items on its side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and the cooldown block name the right windows but carry no numbers, and 'a whiffed E is 13 seconds' misstates Body Slam.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 14s at rank 1. Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2, so Kassadin's escape shortens by more than half across ranks; Explosive Cask is 100/85/70.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad and the don'ts: Riftwalk 5s at rank 1 to 2s at rank 3, Body Slam 14s at rank 1, Explosive Cask 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five separate fields claim Null Sphere silences — early, late, spikes[3].text, wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1] all build advice around a silence that does not exist. The packet already flagged wants.foe[0] as a defect.
audit.why: Riot's text for Null Sphere is damage, channel interruption, and a shield that absorbs magic damage. There is no silence, so 'Null Sphere silences your combo so Happy Hour can't heal you' is advice built on nothing. The genuine interaction runs the other way: Gragas is full magic damage, so the Null Sphere shield plus Void Stone's magic reduction both blunt his burst specifically.
audit.corrected: Silence removed everywhere and replaced with the real interaction — Null Sphere's magic shield stacked on Void Stone reduction is what eats Gragas burst, while Body Slam's stun still lands through it because a pre-6 Kassadin has no Riftwalk to dodge with.

audit.whatIsWrong: The most punishable cooldown was described qualitatively only.
audit.why: Force Pulse at 21s rank 1 and Body Slam at 14s rank 1 are the two windows that decide the lane.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash: you have one ability so Happy Hour barely triggers, and his Void Stone magic-damage reduction blunts what little poke you have, so just last-hit. At level 2 take Q+W: Null Sphere's silence makes diving in risky, but he can't out-sustain your W-empowered auto plus Happy Hour, so take short trades and shove. He has no Riftwalk until 6, so if you land Body Slam (E) into a stun you get a free W-auto-Q before he Flashes — just don't whiff it chasing, because your cooldowns are long and he'll simply walk away.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash: you have one ability so Happy Hour barely triggers, and his Void Stone magic-damage reduction blunts what little poke you have, so just last-hit. At level 2 take Q+W: Null Sphere shields him against magic, so poke through the shield rather than around it, and his chip can't out-sustain your W-empowered auto plus Happy Hour. He has no Riftwalk until 6, so if you land Body Slam (E) into a stun you get a free W-auto-Q before he Flashes — don't whiff it chasing, because E is down 14s at rank 1.

edits.before: Once he finishes Rod of Ages plus Seraph's with a few Riftwalk stacks, the lane flips and you can't pin him — he blinks in, Null Sphere silences your combo so Happy Hour can't heal you, and his Void Stone reduction softens your burst. Don't 1v1 a fed Kassadin in a side lane; your Body Slam and Cask are too telegraphed for him to eat once he's mobile. Shift to teamfighting: save Explosive Cask to peel him off your carries or knock him out of his dive, and let the lead you built earlier close the game before his scaling fully comes online.
edits.after: Once he finishes Rod of Ages plus Seraph's with a few Riftwalk stacks, the lane flips and you can't pin him — Riftwalk is 2s at rank 3, and Null Sphere's magic shield stacked on Void Stone reduction eats a burst that is entirely magic damage. Don't 1v1 a fed Kassadin in a side lane; your Body Slam and Cask are too telegraphed for him to eat once he's mobile. Shift to teamfighting: save Explosive Cask to peel him off your carries or knock him out of his dive, and let the lead you built earlier close the game.
